claim_boundary: DIRAC-015 completes the conditional free-Dirac continuum derivation. DIRAC-016 proves the scoped unsigned cube-translation copy exchange. DIRAC-017 conditionally proves that the same cubical incidence representation carries spin-one-half algebra, including continuous-angle Hamiltonian covariance. DIRAC-018 classifies the square root only within the real, local, flavor-preserving cubical-incidence coefficient class and does not classify arbitrary nonlocal or flavor-mixing roots. DIRAC-019 proves sustained norm-preserving evolution and density-weighted current/group-velocity transport for arbitrary finite positive-frequency spectral families on the stable recurrence-derived continuum branch. DIRAC-020 constructs an explicit normalized finite Fourier frame, proves character-to-momentum compatibility, coherent Parseval density and integrated-current transport, and a finite-update pointwise phase-error bound; a uniform fixed-physical-time convergence rate remains open. DIRAC-021 follows the action-selected rest coefficient through the zero-momentum Dirac Hamiltonian, proves opposite-energy rest phases and their first-order equations, and derives rest frequency 19 and relative branch frequency 38 in native units. A pure branch's global phase is not claimed to be an observable clock. The chain does not establish an SI electron mass, zitterbewegung, electromagnetic coupling or g-factor, unrestricted live-chi localized electron transport, electron identity or formation, or canonical LFM status.
